existing_features.title: Create a single-page Valentine’s Day wish website that presents a playful prompt and two primary choices: a “Yes” button and an evasive “No” (or “Escape”) button.

Implement the evasive behavior for the “No/Escape” button so that when the user attempts to click/tap it, the button moves to a new position within the visible container, making it difficult to select.
When the user clicks “Yes”, transition the UI into a celebration state that shows fireworks/crackers and sparkles animation and displays a Valentine’s Day message.

Add a simple configuration mechanism for branding text so the site name/title and the Valentine’s Day message can be changed without rewriting components (e.g., a single constants/config file used by the UI).

Use a coherent, creative visual theme appropriate for a Valentine’s Day wish site (consistent colors, typography, spacing, and button styling) and apply it across all UI states (initial prompt, evasive interaction, celebration state). Do not use a blue/purple theme.
Add required static image assets (generated) under frontend/public/assets/generated and render them in the UI as part of the visual design (do not serve images through the backend).
